title: Reasoning without Gold Standards: A Proxy-Judge Theory of Autoformalization
abstract: arXiv:2606.09449v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Autoformalization (AF) requires both prover acceptance and fidelity to an informal source, but prover acceptance alone cannot establish fidelity, and expert-validated reference formalizations are costly to obtain. We introduce a reference-free proxy-judge framework, which separates correctness into grounding, statement faithfulness, coverage, and inference, and a theory of how imperfect checks shape iterative refinement. We establish three results. First, for a fixed sequence of candidates, an added proxy's false-positive and false-negative rates bound its effect on the pass-but-wrong rate. Second, damage to a correct formalization requires a false rejection that exposes it to further refinement, and harmful revisions are then retained through unguarded changes, missed changes, or prover progress that overrides judge warnings. translated_title: 无需黄金标准的推理：自动形式化的代理裁判理论
translated_abstract: 自动形式化（AF）既需要证明器的接受，又需要对非正式来源的忠实性，但仅有证明器接受无法确立忠实性，而经专家验证的参考形式化获取成本高昂。我们引入了一个无需参考的代理裁判框架，该框架将正确性分解为接地性、语句忠实性、覆盖与推理四个方面，并建立了关于不完美检查如何塑造迭代精炼的理论。我们确立了三个结果。第一，对于固定的候选序列，新增代理的假阳性率和假阴性率界定了其对“通过但错误”率的影响。第二，对正确形式化的损害需要一个使其暴露于进一步精炼的误拒绝，随后有害修订通过未受保护的更改、被遗漏的更改或覆盖裁判警告的证明器进展而得以保留。第三，对最终通过率的分解区分了持续精炼与新候选的生成……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个无需参考形式化的“代理裁判”理论框架，将自动形式化的正确性分解为接地、语句忠实、覆盖与推理四个维度，并从理论上界定了不完美检查对迭代精炼中“通过但错误”率的影响以及有害修订的留存机制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reference-free proxy-judge theory of autoformalization that decomposes correctness into grounding, statement faithfulness, coverage, and inference, and theoretically bounds how imperfect checks affect the pass-but-wrong rate and how harmful revisions persist during iterative refinement.
